headline: Yelp says Friday through Sunday 10 to 6. The chamber still says Friday 2 to 6.
summary: This is a real family farmstand at 18585 Oak Ridge Lane in Ramona. Chris already shows up as the farmer. Yelp is claimed, 5.0 from four notes, updated this month, with about 22 photos. The phone is (760) 445-2673. Facebook this week prints amormividafarm@gmail.com. There is no shop site that loads. Yelp prints Friday through Sunday 10 to 6. The Ramona Chamber prints Friday 2 to 6, Saturday and Sunday 9 to 2. Instagram has printed 10 to 5:30 and open till dark. A neighbor with a honey run can show up Friday at noon to a stand that is not open yet, or Saturday at 3:00 to a door that already closed.

signals.note: You show up for a farmstand in Ramona. Yelp is claimed, 5.0 from four reviews, with 22 photos. Facebook and Instagram are alive. A neighbor looking for honey, jam, or a hello to the alpacas can find you. Chamber listings still point at amormividafarm.net. That domain did not resolve this week.
